reviews.text: Improve construction of mesh bag!

I love how my legs feel with these socks. These are two XL. I cannot stop them from rolling though, but you can see by the shape of my knees that that may be the problem. I just remeasured my calves and there 23 inches so maybe I need the triple XL.

Tried to sr d picture.  Cant tell if they went thru.  Largest size does not stretch like ads imply.  I sr d an email but dont know if I’ll get a reply.  You eee my last hope.  Tried competitor Viasox I think…it was a real joke!  Sorry

This is only the second time I have worn these socks (I washed them once according to the instructions that I received with my order) and  I was disappointed to see that my big toe had gone through the sock. My toe nails are kept trimmed so they are not the culprit. 
I have worn a variety of brands of compression socks and have never had this problem. 
I would expect these to be more durable considering what you charge for them.

I Have lymphedema with cellulitis and my Right leg which I purchased the socks to wear on that leg started to cause great pain with the sock needing to be removed.  My right leg has been a problem since I developed a stage 4 melanoma with multiple lymph removal 50 years ago.  I was hoping those stockings were different from the usual stockings I have been wearing!

Even though you say the top stretches, it was too tight at the top. Restricted my leg after 3 hours of wear.  I had to take it off.  Was very disappointed.  I am not happy I spent so much for nothing.
The socks left deep marks around my ankles, but didn’t feel any different than any other sock. I bought the appropriate size. Waste of money.
Thry were nice looking, color was good, very soft., BUT they constantly fell down.  I actually do have large calves. But they would not stay up. Won't be wearing them again.
the dtrenhth og compression wad noy as advertised need 20-30 way to light after surgery. disappointing!

The socks were excruciatingly uncomfortable. Too tight around my calf and below the knee. I was screaming in pain trying to  get them on and off though I measured my legs and used your charts. 

I am disabled and have no means to return them to you.

The ankle socks are wonderful in every way but one...the ankle! The socks are plush, and comfortable around the foot, especially with the compression band mid foot. But the ankle was so tight, it caused swelling and discomfort within minutes. I've worn Everstride regular and bamboo socks going on two years now without an issue, so either the sizing is off on the ankle socks or the design of the socks is wrong. I'm still waiting to hear from their customer service.
Too long

The knee socks are great and very comfortable - I wear them every day.  So I decided to try the ankle socks.  They make deep marks in my legs and are not comfortable to wear for more than an hour or so.  I contacted Everstride to return them and was sent a form to fill out.  I then have to pay postage and mail everything to China.  Why don't they have a place for returns in the U.S.?  Not happy.
they ran to small.. i loved them but they were tight
To tight cut off circulation!!!
They are not nearly thought enough.
Send me the Large. These were too big
The fit is not comfortable at all. Maybe I need to try a 3XL instead of a 2XL? Can I exchange these for a larger size?
Too tight in my calf
My ankles swelled more

The socks are over 1 1/2 inches longer than the two brands I wear every day!  Without trying to return to CHINA, I only got a 50% refunds and I ‘get’ to keep socks that do not fit me.   I should have paid more attention and I would not have been scammed for almost $50.,
The socks are too tight for me to wear. They cut  in around my ankles and at the top of the socks.  Extremely disappointed that these do not work for me.
I thought they would have come up a little higher
Too tight at ankles cut off circulation

The socks were size M. I normally take S-M, but these left an indentation on my legs. I sent an email asking if I could return them and exchange them for size L. I didn’t receive a response to my email. I couldn’t find a phone number on your website.
Socks are too long and you won’t refund my full payment unless I send to CHINA.
2 of them ripped a hole through in a week...won't buy them again or recommend...I threw them in the trash

I only wore one set of the socks. They feel great when I put them on . But they are two big I found out they fall down through out the day. I'd like to return them for a smaller size.  The problem is my mom was in the hospital for a week. My my son was in the hospital the week after her. Thank God everything is okay now. But it took up all my time. How can I exchange my socks?

When I got them they in no way resembled the 1st pair I had ordered. The material was different, sizing was different, color was different and the compression was not as good. . So I now have 4 pair of useless stockings.

They are to tight. Need one size larger. Dont know how to exchange

Then another 3 days to despatch my order

The socks were way too small even though I ordered the 2xl.
I never received the compression socks.

My first pair I ordered in July were perfect.  So, I ordered a second time (buy 2 get 2 free). They were not at all like my first pair. The material was different, the sizing was different and the compression was different. So I have one pair I love and 4 I will never wear.
The socks actually hurt my feet and did nothing for the swelling.   Very disappointing!

I ordered the largest size even though it was a couple of sizes larger than my suggested size. I did this because of ankle swelling and the fact that I have slightly larger ankles to begin with. The real problem is the top band. It cut into me so much when I first put them on that I considered taking them off. I kept them on and ended up with a deep indentation not only on the foot that swells more but on the more regular size foot also. I donated the four pairs I received to charity and will no...

I ordered 2 pair. Opened one and attempted to try on one stocking. Too tight to get over heel. 
It looks like a match for foot length, but it is too tight to pull the heel in place. 
I don't know if you will accept returns, but I did not open the second package. I would like to get at least something refunded.
Too loose, you website should have measurements for sizes.
They squish my toes and they just plain don't feel good on my skin

Bamboo socks are way too big. My friend and I need a size smaller. 
Ankle socks are way too tight and small. I need one or two sizes bigger.

I am very disappointed with the 4 pairs of pastel socks I recently bought. Delivery was within a week which was great. I have worn 3 of the  pairs. 
They not as soft as my other bamboo pairs. The knit is tighter and less stretchy particularly around the foot and ankle. 
This makes them more difficult to put on.
They are XL like my others but feel much tighter and not as comfortable.
It had synthetic material which doesn't agree with my skin.
Socks do not fit wide ankles or big feet.

These socks are a joke. I worn them for an hour and a terrible indents on the top of my calves. I tried lowering down some and still had indents.. even my ankles had marks. The only thing that fit right was the foot.

They're not only much too tight, but hurt! They fit my foot perfectly and come to the recommended 2 inches below my knee.

I also didn't find them soft at all! I understand I can't get a refund because I've worn them, but I am very disappointed in your product!

I am unable to put them on. I have difficulty bending my knees to reach my toes to put them on. They are VERY SMALL and don’t stretch enough for me. 

I would like to return them for a REFUND!
I just hate wearing socks especially compression socks I am not interested in nothing you have right now
The colors are beautiful but I just don’t like support it gives. I like a little more support as the original classic.
I need to return these. I believe you offered a 60 day money back guarantee.
I have already sent an email with a picture of a flaw in these beige socks and have not heard back yet!!!!~!
They advertise they dont roll down, yet they do.

They were too tight to get on my foot and over my ankle.  I should have only bought one until I knew that they worked.   Perhaps I need a larger size . . .but I don't want to waste any more money.  I really wanted them to work.  I went to Utah, and had planned to wear them on the plane trips, as well as walking around during the day.  I'm not sure what my net step is . . .I'm very disappointed.
XL are super large for me.
Too small for me.

they are too tight for me

I really needed the socks for a trip I’m taking day after tomorrow, Wednesday.  I still have not received anything from everstride, & am terribly disappointed. Teresa Hodge,
 26 Deer Path Drive, Manchester, TN 37355

I’ve already sent an email that I need a replacement pair. I only received them on the 18th and wore them once and there is a hole. No one has responded to me. I wore think pair and they were comfortable and marvelous.
The band across the foot is too thick and makes it uncomfortable for me to walk. I wish I had ordered more closed toe bamboo socks instead.
Uncomfortable
make the band less tight
I ordered the XL size.  I found them to long, they went over my knees.. I did request a smaller size L and I'm still waiting for a response.

These compression socks don't stay up and they are too tight for my toes. I've had other brands of compression socks where the toe area was loose, did not have compression, so they didn't squeeze my toes. 
When I wore the Everstrides, after 4 hours, I had to take them off. My toes were hurting and they were swollen, especially the big toes.

They 
reek like some weird chemicals I've washed them 3 times now. The smell is still there. I asked for a refund

stop bothering me

Too tight around ankles  leaving indents.

Hi, I really couldn't get on with the size L/2XL as they were still tight around my ankles and my high instep. I wasn't happy with them as I wanted them. Especially for the warmer weather. As my socks fit perfectly but the ankle ones don't. I did keep them on for quite a while but I couldn't cope with them they had to come off. It's a shame you couldn't do a bigger size. I know where to go for my socks though.

I put on a freshly washed pair to wear. Unfortunately,  half way through the day, the socks started falling down my calf until it was around my ankle.   I was  disappointed this happened.   I will try another pair and hopefully the same thing doesn't happen.

I ordered medium s it E. Perhaps I should have ordered large instead either way, the Sox are staying in my dresser drawer instead of on my legs sorry.
I purchased a 4 pk and used the size chart you provided. Too big and won't stay up.

Material feels scratchy this time.  I thought Bamboo was softer.  They are very long, almost over my knee but not quite, so uncomfortable below the knee but not quite long enough to stay up past knee.  Sorry, but I will go back to regular ones that are not bamboo.  Pastels colors are nice though, just material is not soft.
